To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of technology in teacher education is influenced by the attitudes of cooperating teachers, by the type of class the student teacher is working in, and by the student teachers’ attitudes and beliefs.

student teacher attitudes toward technology use are strongly influenced by the attitudes and practices of their cooperating teachers, and that the attitudes and practices are in turn influenced by the type of classes the student teachers teach and the type of school they are assigned to.

the use of technology for lesson preparation and delivery by student teachers is influenced by the following factors: the student teachers’ level of comfort with the technology and the student teachers’ perceptions of the value and importance of technology for teaching.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the factors that influence the use of technology by student teachers in the classroom.
the factors that influence preservice teachers’ use of educational technologies.
the use of technology by student teachers and how it can best be promoted and encouraged.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the most important factor influencing student teachers’ use and understanding of technology in their classrooms was the attitudes and actions of their cooperating teachers.
the use of technology by student teachers is a function of the attitudes of both the student teachers and the cooperating teachers, and the nature of the course content.
student teachers’ uses of technology were most affected by the attitudes and actions of cooperating teachers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the student teachers who were most effective in the use of technology were those who were most comfortable with technology and who had a cooperating teacher who was supportive of their efforts to use it.
the most important factor influencing student teachers’ use and integration of technology is the attitude of their cooperating teachers.
the most significant factors affecting the use of technology by student teachers were the attitude of the cooperating teacher and the type of classes the student teachers were teaching.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the most important factor influencing the effective use of technologies by student teachers is the attitude of their cooperating teachers.
the use of technology in the classroom is greatly influenced by the attitudes and actions of the cooperating teachers.
the use of technology in the classroom is not an isolated event but a complex process involving a number of factors.
